definitions.explanation: A native speaker's command of Japanese — reading comprehension, vocabulary, writing, and the ability to express thoughts clearly. Discussed especially in education.

examples.japanese: {国語力|こくごりょく}を{付|つ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to build up my Japanese language skills.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}は{子供|こども}の{国語力|こくごりょく}を{高|たか}める。
どの{教科|きょうか}でも、{問題|もんだい}を{正|ただ}しく{読|よ}み{取|と}る{国語力|こくごりょく}が{土台|どだい}になる。
examples.english: In every subject, the language ability to read problems correctly is the foundation.

notes:
Composed of {国語|こくご} (national language; Japanese as a school subject) + {力|りょく} (ability). Refers to overall competence in one's native Japanese, not foreign-language skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国語力|こくごりょく}を{付|つ}ける: to build language ability
- {国語力|こくごりょく}を{高|たか}める: to improve language ability
- {国語力|こくごりょく}が{低下|ていか}する: language ability declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語学力|ごがくりょく}: foreign-language ability — usually skill in a non-native language
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}: reading comprehension — one component of {国語力|こくごりょく}
